name: VANTNRG
recent: Vantris Energy 的联营公司（持股50%）获得 Petrobras 价值约 4.1 亿美元（约 17 亿令吉）的海底服务合约，并已启动对 Seagems 合资公司战略选择的评估。公司最新季度营收环比增长 26.9%，但净利润环比下降 48.4%。
notable: 持股50%的合资公司获得 Petrobras 价值约 4.1 亿美元的海底服务合约。
公司与 Paratus Energy 启动对 Seagems 合资公司战略选择的评估，探讨第三方兴趣。
公司秘书 Choong Siew Mun 变更。
risks: 最新季度净利润环比下降 48.4%，净利率从 22.6% 降至 9.2%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日季度，营收为 8.18455 亿令吉，环比增长 26.9%，同比增长 2.1%；净利润为 7530.2 万令吉，环比下降 48.4%，净利率为 9.2%，低于上一季度的 22.6%。

recent_en: Vantris Energy's 50%-owned joint venture secured a subsea services contract from Petrobras worth about USD410 million (approximately RM1.7 billion), and a strategic review of the Seagems JV has been initiated. The company's latest quarterly revenue rose 26.9% QoQ, while net income fell 48.4% QoQ.
notable_en: A 50%-owned joint venture secured a subsea services contract from Petrobras worth about USD410 million.
The company and Paratus Energy initiated a strategic review of the Seagems JV, exploring third-party interest.
Change of company secretary to Choong Siew Mun.
risks_en: Latest quarterly net income fell 48.4% QoQ, with net margin declining from 22.6% to 9.2%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR818.455 million, up 26.9% QoQ and 2.1% YoY; net income was MYR75.302 million, down 48.4% QoQ, with a net margin of 9.2% versus 22.6% in the prior quarter.
